_comment: Public node list for claude-proxy - used by 'proxy-nodes --refresh' when no PROXY_DOMAIN is set.
It is intentionally EMPTY: this repo is public, so real VM addresses don't belong here.
Companies publish their nodes in their own DNS instead (TXT records at _claude-proxy.<domain>,
written automatically by forge's proxydns-manager) and users run 'proxy-nodes --domain <domain>'.
Format (one node object per line, unique never-reused 'slot'):
